name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
one_liner: Call, text or chat 988 any time to reach a trained crisis counselor in the US. Free, confidential, and you don't have to give your name.
best_for: Anyone having thoughts of suicide or in emotional crisis, right now
Someone worried about a friend or family member who may be in crisis
Veterans and service members (press 1 for the Veterans Crisis Line)
not_for: Life-threatening medical emergencies or immediate danger: call 911
Ongoing therapy or regular counseling sessions
Prescriptions, medication refills or a diagnosis
short_description: The national US crisis line: call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, to talk with a trained crisis counselor 24/7 for free.
long_description: The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (formerly the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline) is a US network of local crisis centers funded by SAMHSA and administered by Vibrant Emotional Health. Calling or texting 988, or using the chat at 988lifeline.org, connects you with a trained crisis counselor who listens, helps you get through the moment, can make a safety plan with you, and can connect you to local services. Press 1 reaches the Veterans Crisis Line and press 2 Spanish-language support. The LGBTQ+ youth option (press 3) was defunded in July 2025 and was reported restored on 30 September 2026 after Congress funded it again. You do not need to give your name, and the service is free. Evidence for crisis lines comes from follow-up interviews with callers rather than randomized trials.

pricing.notes: Free to call, text or chat.

privacy.notes: SAMHSA says the administrator, Vibrant, does not sell Lifeline data; local crisis centers keep their own policies, and a 2023 Markup scan found Meta pixels on some local center websites.

seo.title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline provides free 24/7 support via call or text for anyone in emotional distress or suicidal crisis.

faqs.a: 988 is the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, a national mental health emergency number like 911 for physical emergencies. Call or text 988 for free, 24/7 crisis support.
You're connected with a trained crisis counselor at a local crisis center. They'll listen, provide support, help you stay safe, and connect you with local resources. You control the conversation.

faqs.q: Can I text 988 instead of calling?
faqs.a: Yes, you can text 988 for crisis support if you're uncomfortable calling. You'll be connected with a crisis counselor via text message. Both calling and texting are available 24/7.
No, 988 is for any emotional crisis—severe anxiety, overwhelming stress, self-harm urges, or supporting someone else in crisis. You don't need to be suicidal to reach out.

clinical_trials.study: Follow-up interviews with suicidal callers to the Lifeline (calls April 2020 to August 2021)

citation.title: National Suicide Prevention Lifeline (Now 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline): Evaluation of Crisis Call Outcomes for Suicidal Callers

clinical_trials.outcome: Most callers said the call helped; about 41% reported suicidal thoughts returning after the call.
clinical_trials.study_design: Uncontrolled follow-up study (caller interviews about 13 days after the call)

clinical_trials.study: Assessment of suicidal callers to 8 Lifeline crisis centers, with follow-up within 3 weeks

citation.authors: Gould MS, Kalafat J, Harris-Munfakh JL, Kleinman M
citation.title: An evaluation of crisis hotline outcomes. Part 2: Suicidal callers

clinical_trials.outcome: Suicidality fell during the call; hopelessness and psychological pain kept falling in the following weeks (380 completed follow-up).

primary_uses: Talking through thoughts of suicide with a trained counselor
Getting through an emotional crisis in the moment
Getting connected to local crisis and mental health services
Help for someone worried about another person

patient_summary: If you are thinking about suicide or are in emotional crisis, you can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, at any time. A trained counselor at a local crisis center will talk with you, help you stay safe and point you to more help. It is free and you don't have to share your name.

availability.note: US only, 24/7 by call, text and web chat. Press 3 for LGBTQ+ youth was cut in July 2025 and reported restored on 30 Sept 2026.
